I went to school for a few years, so I can read the fertilizer bag at the cooperative, but I still decide based on cash and what worked last season. Last meher I shared a bag of DAP with my neighbor and our barley was good, so I will put some fertilizer and manure on my 0.19 hectare again. I will use my own saved seed, weed by hand with my children, and depend on the rain. My family will spend about 25 days on this plot, and I will not hire workers for such a small piece.
